steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They've lost all humanity...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah. I'm fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can we still reach Blaze, Doctor, and GreyThroat?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good. Keep in touch with them. Help them find their way.

steps.name: Herd
steps.text: (Thirsty howling).

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't feel... anything from you anymore. That faint outline of a thread of hatred, it all came from Mephisto...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have to cleanse it... the poison of Mephisto's hate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I promise. I will.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I've finished mopping up the Reunion stragglers and reached the waypoint. But we've found the situation in the slums is not what we expected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L. G. D. unit guarding the area found no traces of Reunion. I'm going to have to investigate myself.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There's been a reduction in the Infected mutants? Is that your doing?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stay frosty... You never know what danger might be hiding in the shadows.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't let your guard down. These Infected are a lot more to handle than your run-of-the-mill Reunion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Once I finish my work here, I'll send a team to assist you. Keep the channel open. Over and out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: It's me! Reporting in!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not you...

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nothing. Report in.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Yes, Sir! As ordered, we swept the area!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What did you find?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Nothing! Not a single Reunion footprint to be found!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I told you to be on the lookout for anything unusual!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Oh... Oops. We really don't know this area at all.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: I mean, according to procedure, we don't come in here until there's a problem so serious we have to tear down a block or something.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know... The slums don't exist to you, as long as they're quiet.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: When we cut off Reunion, there was a deafening sound coming from this place, and half the residents here vanished.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Look at the toys scattered around our feet... Look at this and tell me there's nothing out of the ordinary.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Was there anything in the plan about evacuating all the residents of the slums?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: ...There are a few things out of the ordinary. Most of the buildings in the district have been abandoned or otherwise ruined.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: The streets that are still here are completely empty. Presumably a result of crossfire between Reunion and the locals.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: And there have been a few fires. We have extinguished them. They seem to have been caused by household functions such as heating and cooking.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: All buildings show signs of forced entry, but there is no trace of any resistance from the residents.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: As for Reunion, there's really no sign of them at all. Just... some cleaning residue.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you care nothing for the civilians here?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: ...Sorry, Sir!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you apologizing for?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: I don't know, Sir!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Whatever... Why should you care about anyone in a place like this?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hurry up and send out some teams to lock down the area!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No one gets in or out. No vehicles either. Reunion or otherwise!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: As for you... You come with me. We're going north.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Yes, Sir!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Shh. Don't make a sound!)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (This way. Quickly.)
Very perceptive.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Preparing to fire!
You should not follow.
Control your subordinates, Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Go find Swire.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: But, Sir...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Who sent you?
I do not answer to you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You think you can run? Try and I'll arrest you on the spot.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're an unidentified armed element of unknown origin. How do you think the L. G. D. is going to treat you? We might just shoot you dead.
Training a new L. G. D. unit would be a waste of Lungmen's time, treasure, and talent.
And eradicating the entire L. G. D. would be a crushing blow to the heart of the Lungmen community. You should not take the risk.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hah! Is that threat supposed to scare me? Or should I be thanking you for your concern over Lungmen's future?
Ch'en, the L. G. D. is the face of Lungmen, as well as a pillar of her community, and an exemplary show of her strength.
And the L. G. D. should stay in its lane.
Don't let it stick its nose where it doesn't belong.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your threats are really not impressing me. Hurry up and answer the question: where did all the locals go?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're one tap of this 'alert all units' button away from making an enemy out of the entire L. G. D.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Or I guess you could take a split second to knock away my sword, slice off my arm, and snatch away this transceiver.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where did all the slum dwellers go?
We will withdraw from this place. Ch'en, you and I both withdraw. For now, let us not interfere with one another.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And where is it you think you're going?
These new-type Infected Reunion is controlling may well interfere with our carefully laid plans.
We will swiftly remove them for the L. G. D., please do your part to exterminate Reunion's main force.
If the L. G. D. seeks to actualize its strategic goals, it should focus on its own duties. You must do that which you must do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wait! You think you can just leave?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Come and go as you please?!
Superintendent Ch'en, let me give you a suggestion.
Do not seek to investigate what has happened here. I look to Lord Wei, and will banter with you no longer.
By the way, cutting off your arm is quite simple. When you stand resolute, you are a hundred times stronger than now.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hey——!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stay back, Swire!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get back here!
I will see myself out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Damn it!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What was that all about? Who was that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lungmen's special forces are on the move. And I don't know if the people of this district are piled in a mass grave somewhere.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Huh? What are you talking about...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't play dumb. You know. Or at least you've heard.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Know what...?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Wait, do you know?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't know. But your grandfather definitely knows.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Huh? Seriously, what are we even talking about? Diu ah! Just come out with it already!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: My grandpa's totally bedridden. I can't get two words out of him!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Being sick in bed means he can't run Lungmen anymore? You know better than I what kind of man your grandfather is!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: No way!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Who are you thinking?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: 'Lin Gray.'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph. Now I'm the one who gets to say 'no way!' Lin runs the slums as his personal fief. There's no way he'd let something like this happen.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Make a few phone calls and ask around. Maybe you'll find out.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Are you calling? Or should I?
